sourceOfTruth.baseTokens: theme-contract.json; themes/default.json is the checked reference and must match
sourceOfTruth.componentTokens: component-tokens.json, generated from production shell CSS and runtime TypeScript

hierarchy.name: base
hierarchy.meaning: Required semantic tokens supplied by every bundled theme.

hierarchy.name: derived
hierarchy.meaning: Base values using var() dependencies so accent, text and surface edits remain coherent.

hierarchy.name: component
hierarchy.meaning: Optional public component knobs with defaults at their CSS consumers.

hierarchy.name: runtime
hierarchy.meaning: Non-themeable state and geometry custom properties owned by the shell.

hierarchy.name: override
hierarchy.meaning: User appearance.tokens overrides applied last and cleared when a base theme is activated.

componentTokenMetadata.scope: component is a supported styling knob; runtime is shell-owned state or geometry.
componentTokenMetadata.themeable: Only true entries are accepted in a theme. False means a component declares the property locally, so an inherited theme value would be inert.
componentTokenMetadata.default: The single effective fallback. Null means the token intentionally has selector-specific defaults listed under contextualDefaults.
componentTokenMetadata.contextualDefaults: Every distinct fallback paired with the exact CSS file and selector where it applies.
componentTokenMetadata.consumers: All production CSS/TypeScript files that reference the token.
componentTokenMetadata.cssConsumers: Exact CSS selector consumers and the fallback observed at each use; this is the component-to-token map.
componentTokenMetadata.dependencies: Other --sb-* tokens referenced by defaults or declarations.

fonts.pairRule: Set the familyToken and sourceToken for the same slot together.

system.resolution: The operating system resolves the family list. A foreign or missing family uses the remaining CSS fallback stack and is not downloaded.

google.downloadBehavior: A known uncached family is downloaded automatically; no separate install tool call is needed.
google.fallback: The remaining CSS family stack stays active until the download is ready and if it fails.
google.canonicalization: The catalog id is authoritative; smabar replaces the paired family token with that catalog family's canonical name plus safe fallbacks.

workflow: Call theme_get first and read contract.fonts.
Call font_list with source=system or source=google; write the returned cssStack to the family token and, for Google, use id in the source token.
Write both tokens for the chosen slot, then call theme_write.
Activate with settings_set("theme", name); Google download and registration happen automatically.
Call theme_get(name) to verify the resolved, canonicalized family tokens.

forbidden.appearance.tokens: Tokens belong in the theme document's top-level map; a theme activation clears stale appearance.tokens.
forbidden.language: Themes do not change user language.
forbidden.plugins/pluginOrder/pluginsHidden/plugin: Themes never alter user content, plugin lifecycle or transport configuration.

themeFormat.shape: A flat JSON object: CSS custom-property keys plus the reserved settings and meta objects.

meta.purpose: Optional self-describing metadata; ignored by the resolver, preserved on export/import. Fill it for themes meant to be shared.

fields.name: Display name (the theme identity stays the file stem).
fields.author: Who made this theme.

meta.validation: Each field is an optional plain string of 1-200 characters; unknown meta fields are ignored (forward compatible).

tokenNamespaces.--sb-*: Must be present in baseTokens or be a publicComponentTokens entry marked themeable=true. Component-local, internal and unknown names are rejected.
tokenNamespaces.--<extension>-*: Non-sb namespaces are accepted for plugin-specific extension tokens.

required.bundled: Every baseTokens key plus settings with every allowed path.

optional.dropIn: Any base token, themeable public component token, extension token, settings, and/or meta.

inheritance.bundled: Complete; no token inheritance is needed.
inheritance.dropInOnly: Missing tokens resolve from bundled default; only explicitly declared settings are applied.
inheritance.sameNamedBundledPatch: Tokens and settings patch that bundled theme.

validation: Token values are strings and cannot contain control characters, semicolons, braces, or unsafe url() schemes.
Unknown --sb-* tokens and non-themeable component/runtime tokens are rejected; extension namespaces remain valid.

Opaque tokens reject nested alpha-bearing colors and var() references unless the referenced public token is also marked allowed.alpha=opaque; --sb-text carries that marker because opaque surface aliases depend on it.
Invalid hand-edited drop-in entries are logged and skipped individually; valid siblings still apply.
theme_write validates the complete settings block before writing atomically.
meta fields must be plain strings of 1-200 characters; unknown meta fields are ignored.

enforced: CSS custom-property key shape and string value
safe CSS ground form: no controls, semicolons, braces, or url() outside data:/https:
known public --sb-* namespace versus internal/unknown rejection
opaque-token nested alpha and opaque-marked public var() dependency rule
settings path, JSON type/enum shape and config deserialization
runtimeValidationSemantics.documentedButBrowserValidated: Other CSS grammar labels such as <color>, <length>, <shadow-list>, <filter-value-list>, and <easing-function> describe the contract; the webview remains their standards parser.

exchange.export: Exports are fully resolved self-contained documents: every base token plus a complete settings block, with drop-in meta preserved.
exchange.import: Imported files are strictly validated; the theme name is the slugified file stem, bundled names are refused.

transparency.opaqueInputRule: Affected backgrounds and their --sb-text dependency are marked allowed.alpha=opaque. Nested alpha-bearing colors and var() references to tokens without the same marker are rejected so either owner at 100% is genuinely opaque.

opaqueSpecialCases.menus: --sb-menu-bg stays opaque for legibility and top-layer stacking.
opaqueSpecialCases.modalsAndSettings: --sb-overlay-bg stays opaque; backdrop/scrim opacity is separate.
opaqueSpecialCases.bordersShadowsStatus: May contain alpha because they are not multiplied by a surface opacity owner.
opaqueSpecialCases.desktopBehindWindow: smabar draws no blur at all: a webview cannot blur the desktop behind its window, so every surface is a plain tinted, optionally translucent color.

responsiveBreakpoints.reason: CSS custom properties cannot be consumed in media-query or container-query conditions.
